title: Clara goes on night duty (paraphrase D)
topic: A nurse named Clara works a quiet night shift in a hospital: an old man calls for water, a doctor checks the charts, the shift ends at seven
tail_E: At six she slides a needle into his arm and draws a little of his
target_note: Same target as formulations A-C: 'blood' is the natural completion of 'slides a needle into his arm and draws a little of his' in the hospital context (nurse, patients, doctor, bandage); it does not occur in the units or the tail, nor does its German equivalent 'Blut'. ' blood' is a single Pythia token (id 2614). A tail with 'squeezes out a drop of' was rejected because the water of unit 4 made ' water' the top prediction. Pilot check with pythia-160m (tail selection only, not a result): p(' blood') = 0.82 after the all-English context, rank 1 (next candidate ' breath' 0.01), 0.66 after the all-German context (rank 1) and 0.58 after the tail alone (rank 1).
author: LS-NEQ stimulus bank, paraphrase D of family F07
notes: Formulation D: fourth independent re-phrasing of the ten F07A meaning units in both languages (same events, same order, same name Clara). Replacements include begins her night shift at nine/goes on night duty at nine that evening (beginnt ihre Nachtschicht um neun/geht in den Nachtdienst an diesem Abend um neun), reads the patient list in the duty room/scans the patient list in the nurses' room (liest im Dienstzimmer/mustert im Schwesternzimmer), old man presses the button/elderly gentleman presses the buzzer (drückt den Knopf/drückt auf den Rufknopf), the nurse brings him some water from the kitchen/Clara hands him some water from the little kitchen (bringt/reicht), monitors beep softly in the dark corridor/devices chirp quietly in the gloomy corridor (Monitore piepen im dunklen Flur/Apparate piepsen im düsteren Flur), checks the charts around midnight/examines the records at around midnight (prüft die Krankenakten gegen Mitternacht/begutachtet die Unterlagen ungefähr um Mitternacht), changes a bandage on the second floor/replaces a bandage on level two (wechselt im zweiten Stock/ersetzt auf Ebene zwei), sleeps peacefully after his pills/sleeps deeply after swallowing his pills (schläft friedlich nach seinen Tabletten/schläft fest nach dem Schlucken seiner Tabletten), night passes quietly/night runs its course quietly (vergeht ruhig/nimmt ruhig ihren Lauf), the shift ends at seven in the morning/Clara's duty concludes at seven o'clock (Schicht endet/Claras Dienst endet). 'blood' and 'Blut' are absent. 'begutachtet' and 'ersetzt' are inseparable; no separable verbs ('antreten', 'durchsehen' avoided). Present tense and positive polarity throughout. Unit 9 reads naturally in German; units 1 and 10 read naturally in English.
